name: wordtoolkit
description: Token-lean native Microsoft Word automation with 15 core/gateway tools and lazy access to 88 native actions.

interface.longDescription: WordToolkit controls the real Microsoft Word application through one persistent native .NET COM STA thread. A small 15-tool MCP surface covers the common lifecycle and batch path; capability, search, inspect and execute gateways negotiate the versioned contract and load any of 88 native actions only when needed. Compact responses omit echoed input and diagnostics by default. The full action set covers saved-package graphs, semantics, deterministic self-contained semantic HTML previews with an explicit non-paginated fidelity class, a unified source-linked dependency graph across OPC, semantic containment, styles, numbering, references, sections, classic charts, content controls, Custom XML stores, binding targets, repeating sections, nested tables and vertical-merge topology, bounded privacy-redacted logical table/grid/merge/floating-position inspection that never returns cell text or raw XML, bounded privacy-redacted content-control/data-binding inspection that never returns Custom XML values, bounded Transitional/Strict DrawingML chart inspection without returning cached point values or opening workbooks, lossless ECMA-376 Part 3 markup-compatibility inventory and explicit application-configuration evaluation without destructive preprocessing, source-linked lint with the first reviewed create-new title repair, semantic comparison, deterministic reversible OPC patch artifacts, guarded three-way package merge, themes, settings, fonts, canonical OfficeMath, comments/threads/people/revisions/moves/permissions, body-only comment rewriting with stable IDs and metadata invariants, modeled effective formatting, atomic style-definition creation/cloning/exact consolidation/proven-unused deletion/primary-name rename and assignment, guarded text edits and lossless tracked-revision decisions plus live formatting, Find/replace, review, tables, formulas, lists, bookmarks, fields, images, notes, headers/footers, editable Office Math, verified native plain/bold/italic/bold-italic MathML and OMML equation scopes, structures, layout, Undo, PDF and Open XML validation. Semantic HTML never loads external relationships or executes active content, keeps links inert and uses visible placeholders for drawings and unsupported extensions; it is not a pagination or Word-layout engine. Dependency keys, XML binding details, table names/layout/source, chart titles/formulas, custom namespace details and other source locations are redacted by default, coverage gaps remain explicit and external targets are never followed. Lint repair, semantic style mutation, comment body mutation, patch and merge application use exact fingerprints and baseline-aware validation; unsafe consumers and ambiguity fail closed. Lint repair and merge create a new file and never overwrite, while semantic style and comment body apply use an atomic recovery backup. Patch and merge retain independent active-content/signature/external-link/binary/error authorizations, while lint repair, semantic style and comment body apply block signed packages outright. Raw patches are confidential; an optional engine envelope supports AES-256-GCM and ECDSA-SHA256 with caller-managed keys, while MCP key provisioning remains intentionally absent. The installed Word object model remains policy-gated; macros, DDE, unsafe raw COM paths and external effects fail closed. The package contains no Python runtime.
defaultPrompt: Open or connect to my Word document and edit it live.
Create a new Word document and write this content immediately.
Generate a long document in one fast native batch.
Add a step-by-step solution with native editable equations.
Add images, comments, footnotes, headers and footers, then export a PDF.
Inspect a saved DOCX and safely accept or reject selected tracked changes.
Lint a saved DOCX and safely repair an empty document title into a new file.
Compare two saved Word documents semantically without opening Word.
Create and safely apply a reversible patch between two saved Word documents.
Consolidate proven exact duplicate custom styles in a saved Word document.
Delete proven-unused custom styles from a saved Word document.
Inspect AlternateContent and compatibility rules without rewriting the saved package.
Inspect table grids, merges, nesting and floating position without returning cell text.
Rewrite only selected saved-DOCX comment bodies without changing anchors or thread metadata.
Render a saved Word package to deterministic semantic HTML without opening Word or claiming page fidelity.
